failure_summary.description: Stopped short of finding all qualifying offers or the true cheapest offer, missing relevant model variants across shops.
Treated support for an RGB accessory as evidence that the motherboard itself has RGB lighting.
Started checkout for one item in a multi-shop purchase but did not complete all required orders or submit the result.

patch.reasoning: The skill already calls for cross-shop ledgers, pagination, attribute verification, and timely closeout. These edits sharpen coverage of model variants, distinguish a product feature from accessory support, and clarify how to finish purchases when selected items are in different shops.

edits.target: For tasks asking for all qualifying offers or every offer tied at a maximum, keep a per-shop ledger of candidates, specifications, and exact offer URLs. After identifying a plausible product, search its distinctive model name or part number in each shop as well as using the general product/category query; equivalent models may have separate shop offers even when a generic query misses them. Count each shop’s relevant results and inspect its remaining pages before concluding that no other qualifying offer exists.
edits.content: For tasks asking for all qualifying offers or every offer tied at a maximum, keep a per-shop ledger of candidates, specifications, and exact offer URLs. Search both general category terms and distinctive model names or part numbers in every shop. When a qualifying or near-qualifying model appears, check relevant sibling models and variants too; do not assume one result represents its whole product family. Count results and inspect all relevant pages before concluding that no other qualifying offer exists.

edits.target: Qualify each distinct offer only when its own title, specifications, or description provide evidence for every required attribute. Do not infer a feature from a customizable display, a similar product, or another variant in the same product family; for example, an LCD alone does not establish GIF playback. If evidence is unclear, inspect that offer’s product details and keep it out of the final qualifying set unless the requirement is supported.
edits.content: Qualify each distinct offer only when its own title, specifications, or description provide evidence for every required attribute. Distinguish a product having a feature from merely supporting an accessory or add-on that provides it: a header, connector, or compatibility claim alone does not prove the feature is included. Do not infer a feature from a customizable display, a similar product, or another variant in the same product family; for example, an LCD alone does not establish GIF playback. If evidence is unclear, inspect that offer’s product details and keep it out of the final qualifying set unless the requirement is supported.

## Complete Multi-Shop Purchases

For an end-to-end task with selected offers from different shops, group the chosen items by shop. Add all selected items for one shop to that shop’s cart and complete its checkout; repeat for each other shop. Before navigating away from a shop, verify its order-received confirmation. Complete every required order before navigating to the solution page and submitting the exact selected offer URLs.
